text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah safely made it through those crucial first three years.
As for what she's doing, today as well—
(Beep-beep-beep-beep, beep-beep-beep-beep)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (My temperature this morning. 37.9°C, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Vivlos? I'll be heading out ahead of you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nnyaaa...
Have a safe triiiip...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall be going.
...Please be careful not to be late.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Well, before that happens, Verxina-senpai or Cheval-san
will probably come pick her up like always, but—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oops. ...It's departure time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Messiah!
Doing your morning training?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Heart-san.
Yes, I was just in the middle of reviewing the menu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: The menu, right—oh, that reminds me! You know that new machine everyone's been talking about? Apparently it's been installed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Oh... Indeed, it does look quite lively.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
New things are just naturally exciting, after all♪
I'm actually on my way to try it out right now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, why don't you join in too?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, thank you for the offer, but I must decline. First, I need to thoroughly review the available documentation on the machine, and then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will consult with Trainer
and decide whether to incorporate it into my daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. —Sorry, honestly, I invited you expecting that exact answer♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Do your best today in your own way. Well then, see you in the classroom!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, see you again.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san, good morning~!
We're on day duty together today. Looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to working with you.
...Oh right, we have dance lessons
this afternoon, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"We need to pick up the music CDs in advance.
After finishing lunch during the break,
let's head to the storage room together."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally, that's right!
Yep, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. If it's with Messiah-san, I don't have to worry about daily duties at all♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft!
You left your logbook at my desk.
Weren't you filling in your class schedule?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah!? I-I totally forgot~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...First, calm down. Let's take things
one step at a time, steadily, Craft-san."

text_block_list.name: Dance Coach
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's all for today's lesson!
Good work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
All right, today's classes are all done~!
Let's hurry over to training!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go, let's go! Since we have dance lessons in the afternoon, it saves us the trouble of changing clothes~.
Ah, I want to run already!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, got a message from the Trainer!
...An interview came up,
so we gotta gather in the Trainer's office in uniform."

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: For real!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (No particular message from Trainer... That means everything is proceeding as normal.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if Craft-san
managed to finish writing the log book?
Maybe I'll just check that before I go—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again today.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have finished my warm-up and stretching, so...
Shall we proceed as planned, starting with the woodchip track?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Well then, I shall be off.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
It's Messiah-san and her Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought.
Strong, beautiful... and so wonderful—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're looking at Messiah again~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
V-Vivlos-san...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, aren't you gonna go talk to them?
Like, 'Let me join your training~!' or something!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I think Mecchan-senpai would be super happy, though~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: T-That's... No, but I'm still nowhere near ready...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I have to go train!
I need to become so much stronger."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: And so... someday, surely—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff... Just one more set—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, that is all for today's menu.
Thank you very much."
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work. ...Are you staying longer?
Thank you for your hard work. ...Are you staying longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Independent training?
Let's see, today... I'm thinking of going to the pool.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It's a period where I'm increasing the workload for both morning training and the routine with Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to swim at a slightly slower pace,
with the primary goal of loosening up my body.
choice_data_list: That's a good idea. Mind if I come along too?
That's a good idea. Should I come along too?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, as I mentioned before,
it's almost entirely for the relaxing effect.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for your supervision.
Please focus on your own work.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...?
Is it just me, or is it getting noisy—?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A-A-Are you seriously telling the truth?!
Hey, are you for real?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Regrettably. Going into the water tonight...
is not something... I would recommend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The water's surface is... stirring.
Mirror reflections. Two sides of the same coin. If one wavers... the other will be affected too—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, no no no, don't explain the details!
You're freaking me out!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words!!
You're saying I shouldn't get in the pool today, right!?
Alright, got it! I'm outta here right—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me.
What do you mean, we're not allowed in the pool...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! M-Messiah, huh.
You sure picked bad timing too...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the full story!
Not like I wanna know, either!!
Anyway, apparently the pool today is super dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Just so you know, I'm dead serious.
Not trusting Cafe on stuff like this goes way past reckless—it's practically suicide.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—No, but...
I have... self-training scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-senpai, um...
Is it impossible to deal with?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey!? Messiah, are you
for real!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Persuading her, or rather... could we talk to her and ask her to go home...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you have the will for it... and
if you possess an unwavering foundation.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we give it a try...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!!
P-Please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I have voluntary training scheduled, so...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real?! Seriously?!
...Yeah, of course you're being serious, you always are...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Daaammit all, shit!!
Alright, fine! I've made up my mind too!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"A-Alright, let's freakin' do this!!
Hey Cafe, what do I gotta do?!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Well then.
First, place these letters on the water's surface――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aagh, damn it, the steps are freaking me out!
Everything's scary! What's with this hand shape anyway!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pocket-senpai, your pinky is in the wrong place.
Like this. Right here, under the ring finger—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You sure have some nerve doing that over and over, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>,

Thank you for your hard work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.9°C (normal), no body pain.
Meals: Attached records for 3 meals + 2 snacks."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Voluntary Training Report: 5 sets leg press,
5 sets rowing, 40 min run (Morning),
12 km swim (Evening)"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Note:
The moon appears to be dim tonight, so please take care on your way home."

Air Messiah will continue to build on this,
and keep on taking one step at a time.
Step by step, she continues forward day by day...
